name: Strong Hire: story coach turn (CO-3, CO-4, CO-9)
description: One coach reply in a story-building session with a simulated candidate (vague, overclaiming, off topic, strong), in the gentle and the direct style. The coach must ask one question at a time and back every story part with the candidate's own words. Prompts are Strong Hire's own (built by scripts/build_strong_hire.py); a model with prompt_tier small gets the small-model variant where the row has one.
